release_read.basis: Headline beat (total revenue $312.4M +13%, subscription revenue $268.5M above the $264-268M guide, non-GAAP EPS $1.38) but the line the stock trades on is soft: net new subscription ARR $51M cc and the FY27 ARR guide raised only $5M at the midpoint ($1,210M) after a 13% run-up into the print; on a name that sold beats 3 of the last 4 times this sizes as a below-implied (12.2%) decline.

release.headline: Commvault Announces Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results

vs_bar.metric: subscription revenue vs company guide midpoint

key_line.metric: net new ARR / FY27 ARR guide
key_line.detail: Subscription ARR $1,103.9M +20% y/y, net new ARR $51M cc; FY27 ARR guide $1,205-1,215M, midpoint up only $5M from $1,205M. No street consensus for net new ARR found.

guidance.detail: FY27 nominally raised (ARR midpoint +$5M; subscription revenue $1,127-1,133M vs $1,119-1,129M; FCF $255-265M vs $250-260M) but Q3 subscription revenue guide $293-297M and FY guide described by Investing.com as below expectations; effectively a disappointing guide against the street.

call.detail: Webcast began 08:30 ET and likely runs until about 09:30; content not reviewed in the time available. It overlaps the open, so its tail is a residual risk for the first minutes.

public_reaction.summary: Investing.com headline 'Commvault falls on weak guidance despite Q2 beat', -9.4% (07:53 ET). No analyst actions searched in the time available.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 153.60 (-8.4%) vs release read -7.0 and implied 12.2%: about fair, a touch beyond the read. Pre-market is stale (16 prints, none in the last 30 minutes, last at 08:43), range 146.68-155.00, so the open is uncertain. Short is +7.7% from the 168.00 entry.

thesis_check.note: Thesis was a repeat of July: run-up into a print traded on net new ARR, beats sold. Headline beat, ARR guide barely moved, guide read as weak, stock down: the thesis played out.

expected.open_lag_note: The pre-market move is clear and on unambiguous guide disappointment, but it is stale (last print 08:43) and the call runs into the open, so the open could land anywhere in the 146.7-155 range; gaps usually fade a little by 10:00, while CVLT's past bmo sell-offs (-19.7%, -31.1%, -16.3%) kept extending through the session.

recommendation.limit_basis: Cover at 148.50 (-11.5% vs 167.73), inside the pre-market range (low 146.68) and just short of the 12.2% option-implied move; CVLT's last three bmo sell-offs ran -16% to -31% on the day, so the session can plausibly reach it, and if it does not the short is covered at the close.
recommendation.reason: De cijfers waren op het eerste gezicht goed, maar de jaarverwachting voor terugkerende omzet ging nauwelijks omhoog en de markt leest de vooruitzichten als zwak; dat is precies het scenario waarop de short gebouwd was. De voorbeurs staat al ongeveer 8,4% lager, ongeveer wat de cijfers rechtvaardigen, maar bij eerdere tegenvallers liep dit aandeel de hele dag verder weg. Zet daarom een kooplimiet om de short te sluiten op 148,50; wordt die niet geraakt, dan gaat de positie bij het slot dicht.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurs voor 09:30 terugveert boven 157 (minder dan 6,5% verlies) of de conference call duidelijk positief wordt ontvangen, dan liever direct bij de opening sluiten.
